tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Switch which page is ACTIVE — the page the content tools target. Subsequent describe_video / inspect_layers / all content tools read and write this page until the active page changes again. Pages are addressed by 0-based index from describe_video's pages block. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_account, list_workspaces, open_project, list_collection, upload_image, upload_audio · Private data: create_account, create_workspace, upload_audio, inspect_layers, set_custom_font · Public sink: create_account, list_workspaces, create_workspace, delete_project, upload_image, upload_audio, find_public_image, detect_text_regions, safe_zones, add_image_layer, add_video_layer, group_layers, set_custom_font, merge_caption_lines, set_image_filename, set_video_clip, freeze_frame · Destructive: list_collection, delete_project, delete_version, clip_processing_status, add_keyframe, set_keyframes_batch, remove_keyframe, add_image_layer, remove_layer, set_text_background, add_color_keyframe, remove_color_keyframe, add_to_collection, remove_from_collection, remove_audio_overlay, cut_range, remove_embed_origin, set_image_filename, freeze_frame, add_speed_keyframe, remove_speed_keyframe, delete_page.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
